description: The restaurants critics agree on in a US city (Michelin, Eater 38, The Infatuation), with vibe tags (fancy/chill, quiet/loud, quick/long, classic/new) and how to book where we know it. For a dinner in the next week (tonight, this weekend), pass date and party_size: places that usually book out weeks ahead move down, and each gets a short-notice read with its reason. Use the returned ids with create_restaurant_vote.
name: find_restaurants
title: Find restaurants
